rules.question: Is this Preview note inside a solo?
rules.owner: the timestamp's flag_solo in src/core/song.h, grouped by Song::solo_sections
rules.note: PreviewNote::solo was a dead copy of the solo flag with no reader; the Preview's solo spans come from Song::solo_sections. A copy of the flag on a Preview note comes back only through this spelling. Decided by: D114 item 22, concept audit M56.
